docs.title: Hello World RSE - Bartek
docs.text: Assignment project using the Pint library for unit conversion.

docs.title: How to use?
docs.text: The calculate_speed function takes distance and time along with their units (e.g., 'km', 'h', 'm', 's') and always returns the result in meters per second.

docs.title: Example:
docs.text:
from hello_world.core import calculate_speed

# How many meters per second?
v = calculate_speed(100, "km", 2, "hours")
print(v)
